summary: Executed backend + frontend access-flow validation on public preview URL. Backend auth API regression passed (7/7). Frontend validated login/register visuals, password-eye toggles, invalid login handling, PIN lock setup/unlock/wrong-attempt cooldown, reset-lock confirmation gate, and responsive login/register overflow matrix (1920/1440/768/390/360/320). Settings navigation showed intermittent non-determinism in repeated runs, which blocked stable completion of full password-mode change/disable retest in this iteration.

ui_bugs.issue: Intermittent failure: clicking settings controls (sidebar/topbar) sometimes leaves app on Library without rendering settings content (settings-hero-badge timeout in repeated runs).

integration_issues.flow: Access flow continuation after successful login
integration_issues.issue: Security-section tests become flaky due to non-deterministic transition into Settings screen; PIN flow could be validated once, but repeated password-flow verification was blocked by navigation instability.

action_items: Stabilize post-login screen navigation state (Library -> Settings) before running deep security modal regressions.
After navigation fix, rerun full password-mode matrix: setup/change/disable, wrong/correct unlock, persistence after reload.

Rerun pending requested flows not fully covered this iteration: file-key dialogs, secret-manager gate actions, vault export/backup password-field visual checks, onboarding step2 access fields, and access-wall forced states (password-required/blocked/license).
critical_code_review_comments: Account/session/login access forms are generally testable with good data-testid coverage; the unstable transition into Settings is currently the main blocker for deterministic access regression automation.

Security lock UI state (wrong PIN -> cooldown -> unlock) behaved consistently in one complete run, indicating lock-store handlers are likely preserved; instability appears around shell screen-switching rather than lock handler logic.

Some messaging in lock-store notifications includes strong guarantees ('ни один байт не покинул устройство'); verify wording policy alignment with user requirement to avoid false/overbroad security claims in access-related UX surfaces.

success_rate.frontend: 72% (core login/register + PIN lock + responsive checks passed; settings navigation flake blocked full password/access-wall matrix)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend screenshots captured under /app/test_reports/screenshots_iter42 (login_load, access_login_success, access_pin_partial, responsive login 1920/390/320). Reliable verified selectors include login-* and lock-* plus mk-* in at least one Settings run. Repeated attempts to enter Settings after fresh login intermittently stayed on Library; prioritize reproducing this transition first, then continue remaining requested access flows.
rca of the issue: Observed flaky post-login screen-switch behavior: despite successful auth and visible settings controls, Settings content did not always mount (settings-hero-badge timeout). Reproduction: fresh login -> immediate click nav-settings or topbar-settings-btn in some runs; app remains on Library. Potential causes: race between shell readiness/splash/state hydration and screen switch handler execution, or click interception timing. Mitigation: enforce deterministic 'ready-for-navigation' signal beyond data-app-ready, then retest access modals.
